book.title: Luk Dowan Weng Olo Luke Dolanebuotabe.

content: Eil sibsibo mako omeb molaibbuo saa wengobe.
Takis moni bokalin naka isa eka naka maki hengmin afeto hengabib isa Yesuse wengo wentom geniba teniba esu tesiba
Felisiei isa eka hekmel weng tekein kemin naka isa yatemniba dosuananiba baaniba Naka ele fatnaneta hengmin nakai bobol wat dokabianea i bakanea imeno wembiam biene? geib kesoa
Yesuse saa weng olo baabenea

Naka make ib isak temo eil sibsib homoni 100 bibabliba mako omeb molanemeo nimin kenamabene? E 99 i betan atosin ye dlane bianiba tetano wembiba kimanin naka ele deibenea monea mako omeb molanebuo hen monea omonea
bobol wat omfanea omnakatoulebnea sein seinea monea
am unanea e nekwal isa bibam sel isa nganabenea te misiba baabenea Nibo seinomo! Ne sibsibo omeb molaibuo hembinia omibo ge baabenamabe inamin kesoa

abilim osa inaminobe. Nakai 99 i i kukubo molot wafu bianiba seimbianiba blib otane hengmin naka make e hengmino deibonea e bobol temo deskinanea omonea Gode omalameo abilimo seinino dot sum tam tlamabobo ge baabesebe.
Monio omeb molanamin saa wengobe.
Eka Yesuse saa weng mako imin baabenea Unang mako monio toeao 10 bibobua mako omeb molanomo ayale eibianoa biino glita bianoa hembinoa omamo
nekwal isa bibam sel isa nganabeno te misiba baabenoa Ne monio omeb molaibu otane memalo ne imin omi kesoa nibo seinomo ge baabenamabo inaminobe.
Hengmin nakae e hengmino deibonea e bobol temo deskinanea omonea Gode omalameo Gode abiseli kla seinhamomabiobo ge baabesebe.
Naka tembale make aalebe deiba onseo saa wengobe.
Eka Yesuse saa weng mako imin baabenea Naka make meme naka teni asu blibbua

ning sake aalebe baabanea Ay kobo monia inamin naminao mo oyenseba olonoba aabe atosino oleb unea ne atosino oleb onanano ge baanea mengane kesoa aalebe inamin namino mako dab oyensea ning sake olone otane
e mo bianeta defaim blimobe. E hebie oleb monea betan mak ye bianea kukub misiam wafu bianea monia inamin naminao webianea denea dileb molanea blimansoa
bibo yo imeno namanoa imen teb sumo tam tloa e inamin namino blim kesoa imen teb sumo amoa
e denea monea naka make betano yo sake okok ota okok kehabea dabane monea e eili kimaba bia
e imen teb sumo abo kesoa e eili asiamo wembib ota esa dowonano gabise otane naka maki e daabaniba imena inamin naminao dlanamino blimobe.
E kla funanea baanea Ne Aye okok nakai kla imen homono wembianiba blibta ne imen teb biania kaanang genabibo,
ne monia ay esu unania baabania Ay keb kin dim osa Gode kin dim osa misiam naibio
kesoa kobo mo baatneneba Kobo ne miinobo genemebe! Kobo baatneneba Kobo ne okok nakabo ge baatnenale genano ge funanea
monea skeimsa ye bebea aalebe atemnea dobhalilanea blublu monea afunea buk buk gahamsea
miine baabanea Ay kobo ne keb kin dim osa Gode kin dim osa misiam naibio kesoa kobo mo baatnenebta Ne miinobo genemebe gese
otane aalebe okok nakai baabenea Ibo hebmamsab youmo ayamo dleb teniba dlusubaniba eka kweil obtabbumine obtabbebaniba eka skil otabbumin osa olusubananiba
eka eil blumakau meno mema eilo matak yota wananiba gaibbua einoa dowonoba seinomo!
Ne funania Ne miin ele kaanebiobo genia debeb molaibu otane e sma afen bianea imin tle kesoa nibo seinomo ge baasea inaniba seinbiba
heke damib unebua binea tenea bib asak tlanea i seinin wengo wentenea
e okok nakae nganabasea tetemea Seinin weng olo mitmakamo fatnamine? gesea
okok nakae baabanea Keb ninge ayam binea imin teteme kesoa keb aye okok nakai baabenea Blumakau meno mema eilo matako wananiba ga dowoibobo gesea
heke weng olo wentenea atliaubasoa e bibo mo unim blim bia aalebe monea baabanea Kobo am tele! Kobo alo mo tlikemone gese

otane miin heke aalebe baabanea Ne bifol homono dimo kima biania okoka inamin naminao daake biania keb wengo mo omdibikemin blim keb wengo kla wente biania nabi otane kobo eil meme meno mo omeb tenebta wananebta ganebta nesa ne nekwal isa dowonobta seinin blim biob otane

keb miin ele moni sumo oleb monea bib mak ye bianea unangi taman deib dleb haabianea monia inamin naminao dileb molanea imin tesea kobo eil blumakau meno mema eilo matako wananeba gebaeba dowonebo gesea
aalebe baabanea Kobo amitie dum binabob kesoa ne inamin namino alukum kebmiobe.
Ne funania Keb ning ele kaanebiobo genia debeb molaibu otane e sma afen bianea imin tle kesoa klayam nanebo genoba ni seinhabuobo ge baabanamabe inaminobo ge baabesebe.
